using LinearAlgebra
using Statistics

function transform_ls(x::AbstractMatrix, b::AbstractMatrix; allow_reflection::Bool=false)::AbstractMatrix
    @assert size(x, 2) >= size(b, 2)
    @assert size(b, 1) == size(x, 1)
    bxt = (b' * x) / size(b, 1)
    U, _, V = svd(bxt)
    r = U * V'
    if !allow_reflection
        flip = ones(size(V, 2))
        flip[end] = sign(det(r))
        r = U * (V .* flip')'
    end
    return r
end

function align(; x::AbstractMatrix, y::AbstractMatrix, x_indices::AbstractVector{Int}, y_indices::AbstractVector{Int})::AbstractMatrix
    if length(x_indices) != length(y_indices)
        error("Number of included indices must be the same for both input arrays, but got for x: $(length(x_indices)), and for y: $(length(y_indices)).")
    end
    x_mean = mean(x[x_indices, :], dims=1)
    y_mean = mean(y[y_indices, :], dims=1)
    centered_x = x .- x_mean
    centered_y = y .- y_mean
    t = transform_ls(centered_x[x_indices, :], centered_y[y_indices, :])
    transformed_x = (centered_x * t') .+ y_mean
    return transformed_x
end

function deviations_from_coords(decoy_coords::AbstractMatrix, gt_coords::AbstractMatrix, align_idxs::Union{AbstractVector{Int}, Nothing}=nothing, include_idxs::Union{AbstractVector{Int}, Nothing}=nothing)::AbstractVector
    if size(decoy_coords) != size(gt_coords)
        error("decoy_coords.shape and gt_coords.shape must match. Found: $(size(decoy_coords)) and $(size(gt_coords)).")
    end
    if isnothing(include_idxs)
        include_idxs = collect(1:size(decoy_coords, 1))
    end
    if isnothing(align_idxs)
        align_idxs = include_idxs
    end
    aligned_decoy_coords = align(x=decoy_coords, y=gt_coords, x_indices=align_idxs, y_indices=align_idxs)
    deviations = [norm(aligned_decoy_coords[i, :] - gt_coords[i, :]) for i in include_idxs]
    return deviations
end

function rmsd_from_coords(decoy_coords::AbstractMatrix, gt_coords::AbstractMatrix, align_idxs::Union{AbstractVector{Int}, Nothing}=nothing, include_idxs::Union{AbstractVector{Int}, Nothing}=nothing)::Float64
    deviations = deviations_from_coords(decoy_coords, gt_coords, align_idxs, include_idxs)
    return sqrt(mean(deviations .^ 2))
end

struct AtomLayout
    atom_name::Array{String}
    res_id::Array{Int}
    chain_id::Array{String}
    atom_element::Union{Array{String}, Nothing}
    res_name::Union{Array{String}, Nothing}
    chain_type::Union{Array{String}, Nothing}
end

function AtomLayout(atom_name::Array{String}, res_id::Array{Int}, chain_id::Array{String}, atom_element::Union{Array{String}, Nothing} = nothing, res_name::Union{Array{String}, Nothing} = nothing, chain_type::Union{Array{String}, Nothing} = nothing)
    if eltype(atom_name) != String
        throw(ArgumentError("atom_name must have dtype String"))
    end
    return AtomLayout(atom_name, res_id, chain_id, atom_element, res_name, chain_type)
end

function Base.getindex(layout::AtomLayout, key)
    return AtomLayout(layout.atom_name[key], layout.res_id[key], layout.chain_id[key], layout.atom_element !== nothing ? layout.atom_element[key] : nothing, layout.res_name !== nothing ? layout.res_name[key] : nothing, layout.chain_type !== nothing ? layout.chain_type[key] : nothing)
end

function Base.:(==)(layout1::AtomLayout, layout2::AtomLayout)
    if !all(layout1.atom_name .== layout2.atom_name)
        return false
    end
    mask = map(!isempty, layout1.atom_name)
    for field in (:res_id, :chain_id)
        my_arr = getfield(layout1, field)
        other_arr = getfield(layout2, field)
        if !all(my_arr[mask] .== other_arr[mask])
            return false
        end
    end
    for field in (:atom_element, :res_name, :chain_type)
        my_arr = getfield(layout1, field)
        other_arr = getfield(layout2, field)
        if my_arr !== nothing && other_arr !== nothing
            if !all(my_arr[mask] .== other_arr[mask])
                return false
            end
        end
    end
    return true
end

function copy_and_pad_to(layout::AtomLayout, shape::Tuple{Vararg{Int}})
    if length(shape) != ndims(layout.atom_name)
        throw(ArgumentError("Incompatible shape $shape. Current layout has shape $(size(layout.atom_name))."))
    end
    if any(new < old for (old, new) in zip(size(layout.atom_name), shape))
        throw(ArgumentError("Can't pad to a smaller shape. Current layout has shape $(size(layout.atom_name)) and you requested shape $shape."))
    end
    pad_width = [(0, new - old) for (old, new) in zip(size(layout.atom_name), shape)]
    pad_val = ""
    return AtomLayout(padarray(layout.atom_name, pad_width, pad_val), padarray(layout.res_id, pad_width, 0), padarray(layout.chain_id, pad_width, pad_val), layout.atom_element !== nothing ? padarray(layout.atom_element, pad_width, pad_val) : nothing, layout.res_name !== nothing ? padarray(layout.res_name, pad_width, pad_val) : nothing, layout.chain_type !== nothing ? padarray(layout.chain_type, pad_width, pad_val) : nothing)
end

function to_array(layout::AtomLayout)
    if layout.atom_element === nothing || layout.res_name === nothing || layout.chain_type === nothing

const _T = Any
const _ConfigT = BaseConfig

function _strip_optional(t::Type)
    if isa(t, Union) && Nothing in t.types
        non_nothing_types = filter(x -> x != Nothing, t.types)
        if length(non_nothing_types) == 1
            return non_nothing_types[1]
        end
    end
    return t
end

const _NO_UPDATE = :_NO_UPDATE

struct _Autocreate
    defaults::Dict{Symbol, Any}
end

function autocreate(;defaults...)
    return _Autocreate(Dict{Symbol, Any}(defaults))
end

function _clone_field(field::Field, new_default)
    if new_default === _NO_UPDATE
        return copy(field)
    end
    return Field(field.name, field.type, new_default, field.is_default, field.init, field.kw_only, field.repr, field.hash, field.compare, field.metadata)
end

abstract type BaseConfig end

function get_field_types(::Type{T}) where T <: BaseConfig
    field_names = fieldnames(T)
    field_types = T.types
    return Dict(zip(field_names, field_types))
end

function get_field_defaults(instance::T) where T <: BaseConfig
    field_names = fieldnames(T)
    defaults = Dict{Symbol, Any}()
    for name in field_names
        try
            defaults[name] = getfield(instance, name)
        catch e
            defaults[name] = _NO_UPDATE
        end
    end
    return defaults
end

function _post_init!(self::T) where T <: BaseConfig
    field_types = get_field_types(T)
    field_names = fieldnames(T)
    for field_name in field_names
        field_type = _strip_optional(field_types[field_name])
        field_value = getfield(self, field_name)
        if field_value === nothing
            continue
        end
        try
            if isa(field_value, _Autocreate)
                new_instance = field_type(;field_value.defaults...)
                setfield!(self, field_name, new_instance)
            elseif isa(field_value, AbstractDict)
                args = Dict{Symbol, Any}()
                field_default = get_field_defaults(self)[field_name]
                if isa(field_default, _Autocreate)
                    merge!(args, field_default.defaults)
                end
                for (k, v) in field_value
                    args[Symbol(k)] = v
                end
                new_instance = field_type(;args...)
                setfield!(self, field_name, new_instance)
            end
        catch e
            error("Failure while coercing field $field_name of $(typeof(self))")
        end
    end
end

function as_dict(self::T) where T <: BaseConfig
    result = Dict{Symbol, Any}()
    for field_name in fieldnames(T)
        field_value = getfield(self, field_name)
        result[field_name] = field_value
    end
    field_types = get_field_types(T)
    for (field_name, field_type) in field_types
        field_value = getfield(self, field_name)
        if isa(field_value, BaseConfig)
            result[field_name] = as_dict(field_value)
        end
    end
    return result
end

using Serialization
using ProgressMeter

const _CCD_PICKLE_FILE = joinpath(dirname(@__DIR__), "constants", "converters", "ccd.pickle")

function find_ions_and_glycans_in_ccd(ccd::Dict{String, Dict{String, Vector{String}}})::Dict{String, Set{String}}
    glycans_linking = String[]
    glycans_other = String[]
    ions = String[]
    for (name, comp) in ProgressMeter.progress(ccd)
        if name == "UNX"
            continue
        end
        comp_type = lowercase(comp["_chem_comp.type"][1])
        if contains(comp_type, "saccharide")
            if contains(comp_type, "linking")
                push!(glycans_linking, name)
            else
                push!(glycans_other, name)
            end
        end
        comp_name = lowercase(comp["_chem_comp.name"][1])
        if contains(comp_name, "ion")
            push!(ions, name)
        end
    end
    result = Dict{String, Set{String}}("glycans_linking" => Set{String}(glycans_linking), "glycans_other" => Set{String}(glycans_other), "ions" => Set{String}(ions))
    return result
end

function main(argv::Vector{String})::Nothing
    if length(argv) != 2
        throw(ArgumentError("Directory to write to must be specified as a command-line argument."))
    end
    println("Loading $_CCD_PICKLE_FILE")
    ccd = deserialize(_CCD_PICKLE_FILE)
    output_path = argv[2]
    mkpath(dirname(output_path))
    println("Finding ions and glycans")
    result = find_ions_and_glycans_in_ccd(ccd)
    println("Writing to $output_path")
    open(output_path, "w") do f
        serialize(f, result)
    end
    println("Done")
    return nothing
end

struct Ccd <: AbstractDict{String, Dict{String, Vector{String}}}
    _dict::Dict{String, Dict{String, Vector{String}}}
    _ccd_pickle_path::String
    function Ccd(; ccd_pickle_path::Union{String, Nothing} = nothing, user_ccd::Union{String, Nothing} = nothing)
        path = ccd_pickle_path === nothing ? _CCD_PICKLE_FILE_CHEM : ccd_pickle_path
        dict_data = _load_ccd_pickle_cached(path)
        if user_ccd !== nothing
            if isempty(user_ccd)
                throw(ArgumentError("User CCD cannot be an empty string."))
            end
        end
        new(dict_data, path)
    end
end

function mmcif_to_info(mmcif::Dict{String, Vector{String}})::ComponentInfo
    names = get(mmcif, "_chem_comp.name", String[])
    types = get(mmcif, "_chem_comp.type", String[])
    mon_nstd_parent_comp_ids = get(mmcif, "_chem_comp.mon_nstd_parent_comp_id", String[])
    pdbx_synonyms = get(mmcif, "_chem_comp.pdbx_synonyms", String[])
    formulas = get(mmcif, "_chem_comp.formula", String[])
    formula_weights = get(mmcif, "_chem_comp.formula_weight", String[])
    function front_or_empty(values::Vector{String})::String
        return isempty(values) ? "" : values[1]
    end
    type_ = front_or_empty(types)
    mon_nstd_parent_comp_id = front_or_empty(mon_nstd_parent_comp_ids)
    if lowercase(type_) == "non-polymer"
        mon_nstd_flag = "."
    elseif mon_nstd_parent_comp_id == "?"
        mon_nstd_flag = "y"
    else
        mon_nstd_flag = "n"
    end
    canonical_pdbx_smiles = ""
    fallback_pdbx_smiles = ""
    descriptor_types = get(mmcif, "_pdbx_chem_comp_descriptor.type", String[])
    descriptors = get(mmcif, "_pdbx_chem_comp_descriptor.descriptor", String[])
    programs = get(mmcif, "_pdbx_chem_comp_descriptor.program", String[])
    for (descriptor_type, descriptor, program) in zip(descriptor_types, descriptors, programs)
        if descriptor_type == "SMILES_CANONICAL"
            if isempty(canonical_pdbx_smiles) || program == "OpenEye OEToolkits"
                canonical_pdbx_smiles = descriptor
            end
        end
        if isempty(fallback_pdbx_smiles) && descriptor_type == "SMILES"
            fallback_pdbx_smiles = descriptor
        end
    end
    pdbx_smiles = canonical_pdbx_smiles == "" ? fallback_pdbx_smiles : canonical_pdbx_smiles
    return ComponentInfo(name = front_or_empty(names), type = type_, pdbx_synonyms = front_or_empty(pdbx_synonyms), formula = front_or_empty(formulas), formula_weight = front_or_empty(formula_weights), mon_nstd_parent_comp_id = mon_nstd_parent_comp_id, mon_nstd_flag = mon_nstd_flag, pdbx_smiles = pdbx_smiles)
end

const component_name_to_info_cache = Dict{Tuple{Ccd, String}, Union{ComponentInfo, Nothing}}()
function component_name_to_info(ccd::Ccd, res_name::String)::Union{ComponentInfo, Nothing}
    key = (ccd, res_name)
    if !haskey(component_name_to_info_cache, key)
        component = get(ccd, res_name, nothing)
        if component === nothing
            component_name_to_info_cache[key] = nothing
        else
            component_name_to_info_cache[key] = mmcif_to_info(component)
        end
    end
    return component_name_to_info_cache[key]
end

function type_symbol(ccd::Ccd, res_name::String, atom_name::String)::String
    res = get(ccd, res_name, nothing)
    if res === nothing
        return "?"
    end
    try
        atom_ids = res["_chem_comp_atom.atom_id"]
        type_symbols = res["_chem_comp_atom.type_symbol"]
        idx = findfirst(==(atom_name), atom_ids)
        if idx !== nothing
            return type_symbols[idx]
        else
            return "?"
        end
    catch e
        return "?"
    end
end
